messages:
zoe: Hey team — bringing up hummingbird-7b int4 canary. Seeing OOMs on 2/8 canaries and a small quality regression on the translation eval. Logs attached, anyone able to triage?

rahul: grabbing logs now. which runtime/config was used?

zoe: config pasted:```yaml
model: hummingbird-7b-int4
max_new_tokens: 128
batch_size: 6
prefetch_kv: true
kv_eviction_policy: lru
warmup: true
```

kia: OOM stack (from node-4):
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.3 GiB (GPU 0; 40 GiB total, 36.2 GiB already allocated)
  at tensorrt_backend::alloc(...)
  at kv_cache::reserve_slots(...)
```

marina: Perf notes: tail p99 spikes when batch_size > 4. For same prompts p99 goes from ~180ms -> ~340ms.

zoe: hypothesis: int4 quant + batch 6 + max_new_tokens=128 leads to KV cache ballooning and some fragmentation during warmup + prefetch. Could be allocator fragmentation not just raw mem use.

rahul: ok. experiments to run: reduce max_new_tokens -> 64, batch_size -> 3; also test prefetch_kv=false and kv_trim_on_alloc=true. I'll kick runs.

kia: adding: try slot_reserve_pct=12 (reserve a cushion) and a warmstart-only prefix cache to avoid large transient allocations on cold sessions.

marina: quality side — our translation benchmark shows BLEU down ~1.8 with this int4 build vs fp16. Might be quant calibration (outlier dims). Add a short eval with per-layer calibration and my small eval harness.

rahul: queued perf runs: 6155554330 (batch=3,max_new=64) and 6155554340 (batch=3,max_new=64,prefetch=false,kv_trim=true).

deploy-bot: Canary roll 6155554330 -> hummingbird-7b-int4 (batch=3, max_new_tokens=64) started by @rahul.

kia: quick smoke (2k requests) on canary 6155554330: no OOMs, tail p99 ~210ms, avg ~60ms.

zoe: nice. rahul please run full perf + quality. kia try the prefetch=false + kv_trim run and compare fragmentation metrics (slot churn, peak_alloc, free_segments).

marina: gating plan: hold canary 24h, daily quality checks. If BLEU regression >1.0 absolute, roll back.

rahul: early evals: perplexity +2% but BLEU recovered to -0.4. Full metrics ETA ~3h (running full translation set + SQuAD sanity).

zoe: provisional decision: if stable, update hummingbird-7b-int4 defaults -> max_new_tokens=64, default_batch_size=4, prefetch_kv=false. Also document slot_reserve_pct:12 as a mitigation.

kia: also proposing allocator tweak: enable compact_on_alloc for small-allocation bursts; I'll PR a safe rollout.

marina: will prepare rollback playbook and automated quality alert (threshold BLEU drop 0.8).

rahul: full run finished: no OOMs on canary fleet, p99 improved vs initial canary, BLEU -0.35. Uploading perf dashboard link: https://dashboards.internal/runs/6155554330

zoe: perfect. action items: rahul merge config change to canary defaults, kia open allocator PR with slot_reserve and compact_on_alloc toggle, marina enable quality gating rule, I'll approve and schedule update to baseline defaults after 48h stable.

marina: ack. will watch for drift overnight.

zoe: thanks team! :thumbsup:
